purpose: Provide product-code breakdowns so the app can group one WS title into separate releases/boosters without changing translation files.
grouping_rule: Use card id or printing id. Product code is the substring before the final hyphen and card number, e.g. SFN/S108-001 -> SFN/S108.
display_name_note: suggested_display_name uses the primary official WS expansion name matched from the official card list API. official_expansions keeps all official names under the same product code, such as TD plus booster products.
trait_policy: Trait names inside 《》 remain Japanese in translations for physical-card lookup.
